text: Caroline (a.k.a. Mel) is LGBTQ and had an upsetting hike encounter with religious conservatives, reinforcing her view that LGBTQ rights work remains. Melanie does pottery; Caroline praised her colorful bowl, and painting is Melanie's creative outlet and comfort. Both value their friendship and supportive friends. They attended last year's Pride fest and plan a special summer outing together, just the two of them, possibly exploring nature.
